description: How this project's versions are kept current: libraries, Docker images, GitHub actions, the tools in .tool-versions, OpenTofu providers and modules, Helm charts. One repository: this file is the whole policy. Several repositories: move it to a config repository of your own (owner/renovate-config, as default.json) and leave here only { "extends": ["github>owner/renovate-config"] }. Small updates merge themselves once Renovate sees every check pass (Renovate merges, not GitHub: platformAutomerge off, so nothing merges before the checks ran); new major versions, Node and the tool images the checks never run wait for the owner.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Small updates of everything in one pull request a week, merged by Renovate once every check on it passes (libraries below 1.0 excluded: their minor versions may break)
A new major version is its own pull request: read what changes before taking it
Node only moves between long-term-support versions (the even ones), and in step everywhere it is named; never merged by itself: it is what everything runs on
The tool images the kit runs with Docker (helm, k6, the scanners, OpenTofu): the gate never runs them, so green checks prove nothing; one pull request, for the owner to try
OpenTofu providers and modules together, so a stack moves as one

customManagers.description: The tool images the kit runs with Docker (the scanners in secops.mjs, k6 in load.mjs, OpenTofu, Terraform and Trivy in infracheck.mjs and infraplan.mjs), marked with a renovate: docker comment
